## What it is

Number 2, rendered yellow. Front-left, 225°. Recessed 2. Four hooks, and the highest one on the coil. The tube runs about 26 mm past that hook and stops.

## Design notes

- Print it on its side, flat face down. The C is the layer outline.
- The foot is the same 6.0 × 3.2 mm tab as the other towers. The 2 is recessed into the top face of the rib.
- The neck is 6 mm, with a 3 mm fillet each side where it leaves the rib.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't print it standing up.
- Don't swap it with number 1. The tab fits every slot. The hooks would no longer be one helix.

## Changelog

- 2026-11-25: integrated hooks. This tower carries the cut-end side of the coil. The old fifteenth hook, on green, is not on the tube.
